Crude Oil Tops $106, Hits Four-Month High

According to Trading Economics market data, crude oil prices rose above $106 per barrel on September 15, 2026, U.S. Eastern Time, reaching a four-month high. The move was driven by tighter Middle East supply, with Saudi Arabia shutting the East-West pipeline, affecting the transport of 7 million barrels of crude per day, while protests also halted operations at several Libyan oil fields. In addition, China drew down oil inventories and increased orders in August. — link
